import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import sys
from time import perf_counter

ROOT = Path('/home/exedev/.codex/worktrees/93cf/clifft-codex')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tools/profile'))
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/merlin-research-2026-10-06')
from study_circuit_noise import Model, synthetic_bt_noise, source
from profile_bt27_fault_specialization import optimize, FIXTURE
import clifft
import merlin

os.sched_setaffinity(0, {min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))})
generator = importlib.import_module('benchmarks.protocols.code_switching')
sources = {
    'bt27_one_layer': source(noise='DEPOLARIZE1(0.001)'),
    'bt27_full_noise': synthetic_bt_noise(source(), {'prep', 'phase', 'decoder'}, .001),
    'cultivation_d5_p001': (FIXTURE.parent / 'cultivation_d5.stim').read_text().replace('(0.005)', '(0.001)'),
    'bt81_full_noise': synthetic_bt_noise(generator.build_code_switching_case('bt81', p_phys=0, target_scoring=False).circuit, {'prep', 'phase', 'decoder'}, .001),
}
document = {
    'shots_per_batch': 512, 'measured_batches': 3, 'warmup_shots': 32,
    'cpu_affinity': sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
    'outputs': 'All records, detectors and declared observables; no added probes or postselection',
    'noise': 'Original stochastic noise instructions executed each shot; no fixed-history specialization',
    'limitations': 'Small local timing check; no end-to-end benchmark of the experimental path, no per-case peak memory measurement',
    'models': {},
}
for name, text in sources.items():
    row = {'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Model(text).render(None).encode()).hexdigest()}
    document['models'][name] = row
    print('Checking', name, flush=True)
    try:
        start = perf_counter()
        sampler = merlin.CircuitSampler(text, seed=20261010)
        setup = perf_counter() - start
        sampler.sample(32)
        times = []
        for _ in range(3):
            start = perf_counter()
            sample = sampler.sample(512)
            times.append(perf_counter() - start)
            assert sample.measurements.shape[0] == 512
        row['merlin'] = {'setup_seconds': setup, 'sample_seconds': times, 'median_seconds_per_shot': statistics.median(times) / 512, 'record_columns': sample.measurements.shape[1]}
    except Exception as error:
        row['merlin'] = {'error': str(error)}
    if name.startswith('cultivation'):
        start = perf_counter()
        program = clifft.compile(text)
        setup = perf_counter() - start
        assert program.peak_active_width <= 16
        clifft.sample(program, shots=32, seed=901, threads=1)
        times = []
        for seed in (912, 923, 934):
            start = perf_counter()
            sample = clifft.sample(program, shots=512, seed=seed, threads=1)
            times.append(perf_counter() - start)
            assert sample.measurements.shape[0] == 512
        row['clifft'] = {'setup_seconds': setup, 'sample_seconds': times, 'median_seconds_per_shot': statistics.median(times) / 512, 'peak_width': program.peak_active_width}
    else:
        _, stats = optimize(text)
        row['clifft'] = {'peak_width': stats['peak_width'], 'execution': 'not run: dense width exceeds 16-qubit study budget'}
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
    Path('/tmp/noise-baseline-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2) + '\n')
